steps.name: When the admin selects the "Люди" tab
And the admin waits for 4 people cards to be loaded
Then exactly 4 cards are displayed
And the "Опублікувати" button becomes disabled
When the admin remembers the original descriptions and counters of all cards
And the admin clears the "Опис" field of card 2 and types 60 characters
Then the "Опис" field of card 2 consists of 60 repeated characters "А"
And the character counter for card 2 reads "60/60"
When the admin types an additional character "B" into the "Опис" field of card 2
Then the "Опис" field of card 2 consists of 60 repeated characters "А"
And the character counter for card 2 reads "60/60"
When the admin triggers validation by blurring the "Опис" field of card 2
Then no validation message is displayed under the "Опис" field of card 2
When the admin clears the "Опис" field of card 2
And the admin pastes text "BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBA" into the "Опис" field of card 2
Then the "Опис" field of card 2 consists of 60 repeated characters "B"
And the character counter for card 2 reads "60/60"
When the admin triggers validation by blurring the "Опис" field of card 2
Then no validation message is displayed under the "Опис" field of card 2
And the "Опублікувати" button becomes enabled
When the admin refreshes the page and reopens the "Люди" tab with 4 cards
Then all cards display their original descriptions and counters
And the "Опублікувати" button becomes disabled
